edges.reason: mintGiveawayNFT increments GIVEAWAY_MINTED for each minted token.
mintPreSaleNFT increments PRESALE_MINTED for each minted token.
mintSaleNFT increments SALE_MINTED for each minted token.
mintPreSaleNFT reads and writes users[msg.sender].presalemint.
mintSaleNFT reads and writes users[msg.sender].salemint.
mintPreSaleNFT verifies the caller proof against merkleRoot.
updateMerkleRoot writes the merkleRoot state variable.
_randMod increments the nonce state variable on every call.
_randMod reads and writes the indices swap-and-pop array.
mintPreSaleNFT requires presaleEnable to be true.
mintSaleNFT requires saleEnable to be true.
mintPreSaleNFT compares msg.value against PRESALE_PRICE.
mintSaleNFT compares msg.value against SALE_PRICE.
updateSalePrice writes SALE_PRICE.
updatePreSalePrice writes PRESALE_PRICE.
setURI writes the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI reads baseURI when building the metadata URI.
setSaleStatus writes the saleEnable flag.
setPreSaleStatus writes the presaleEnable flag.
updateSaleMintLimit writes MAX_MINT_SALE.
updatePreSaleMintLimit writes MAX_MINT_PRESALE.
updateMintLimitPerTransectionPreSale writes MAX_BY_MINT_IN_TRANSACTION_PRESALE.
updateMintLimitPerTransectionSale writes MAX_BY_MINT_IN_TRANSACTION_SALE.
mintPreSaleNFT bounds users[msg.sender].presalemint by MAX_MINT_PRESALE.
mintSaleNFT bounds users[msg.sender].salemint by MAX_MINT_SALE.
mintPreSaleNFT bounds _count by MAX_BY_MINT_IN_TRANSACTION_PRESALE.
mintSaleNFT bounds _count by MAX_BY_MINT_IN_TRANSACTION_SALE.
mintPreSaleNFT enforces totalSupply + _count <= MAX_NFT.
mintSaleNFT enforces totalSupply + _count <= MAX_NFT.
mintGiveawayNFT enforces totalSupply + _count <= MAX_NFT.
_randMod computes totalSize as MAX_NFT - nonce.
msg.sender forms the merkle leaf and keys the users mapping in mintPreSaleNFT.
msg.sender keys the users mapping and receives the minted token in mintSaleNFT.
msg.sender is mixed into the _randMod pseudo-random seed, making the drawn token id caller-influenced.
withdraw sends the contract balance to msg.sender.
block.timestamp is used as a randomness seed in _randMod, creating a timestamp dependency.
msg.sender feeds the unsafe pseudo-random seed computation.
block.timestamp feeds the unsafe pseudo-random seed computation.
_randMod performs the unsafe timestamp/difficulty dependent randomness operation.
mintGiveawayNFT calls _randMod for each minted token.
mintPreSaleNFT calls _randMod for each minted token.
mintSaleNFT calls _randMod for each minted token.
withdraw executes the low-level send operation to msg.sender.
mintPreSaleNFT performs arithmetic on PRESALE_MINTED and users[msg.sender].presalemint.
mintSaleNFT performs arithmetic on SALE_MINTED and users[msg.sender].salemint.
mintGiveawayNFT performs arithmetic on GIVEAWAY_MINTED.
mintPreSaleNFT calls _safeMint, which externally invokes onERC721Received before users[msg.sender].presalemint is updated.
mintSaleNFT calls _safeMint, which externally invokes onERC721Received before users[msg.sender].salemint is updated.
A malicious receiver can reenter mintPreSaleNFT through the ERC721 receiver callback while mint counters are stale.
A malicious receiver can reenter mintSaleNFT through the ERC721 receiver callback while mint counters are stale.
_to parameter is the recipient used by mintGiveawayNFT.
_count parameter drives the giveaway mint loop.
_count parameter drives the presale mint loop and limit checks.
merkleProof parameter is passed to MerkleProof.verify.
_count parameter drives the public sale mint loop and limit checks.
newPrice parameter is assigned to SALE_PRICE.
status parameter is assigned to saleEnable.
newLimit parameter is assigned to MAX_MINT_SALE.
newRoot parameter is assigned to merkleRoot.
_URI parameter is assigned to baseURI.
mintPreSaleNFT stores totalSupply() in a local variable for the cap check.
mintSaleNFT stores totalSupply() in a local variable for the cap check.
mintGiveawayNFT stores totalSupply() in a local variable for the cap check.
mintPreSaleNFT assigns the _randMod result to the local tokenId.
mintSaleNFT assigns the _randMod result to the local tokenId.
mintGiveawayNFT assigns the _randMod result to the local tokenId.
mintPreSaleNFT builds the merkle leaf node from msg.sender.
_randMod derives the local index from nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty and block.timestamp.
_randMod computes the local totalSize as MAX_NFT - nonce.
_randMod resolves the local value from the indices array.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only feeds the giveaway mint function.
Parameter _count only controls the giveaway mint loop and cap check.
Parameter _count only controls the presale mint loop and limit checks.
Parameter merkleProof is only consumed by the merkle verification in mintPreSaleNFT.
Parameter _count only controls the public sale mint loop and limit checks.
Parameter newPrice is directly assigned to SALE_PRICE inside updateSalePrice.
Parameter status is directly assigned to saleEnable inside setSaleStatus.
Parameter newLimit is directly assigned to MAX_MINT_SALE inside updateSaleMintLimit.
Parameter newRoot is directly assigned to merkleRoot inside updateMerkleRoot.
Parameter _URI is directly assigned to baseURI inside setURI.
Local totalSupply is a cached supply value used only for the mint cap checks.
Local tokenId is the value produced by _randMod and consumed by _safeMint.
Local node is the merkle leaf derived from msg.sender inside mintPreSaleNFT.
Local index is derived from the _randMod seed inputs.
Local totalSize is computed from MAX_NFT and nonce inside _randMod.
Local value is resolved from the indices array inside _randMod.
